# iru_custom_profiles (Data Source)

Look up Iru custom profiles, optionally filtered by name. Use the returned `id` for `library_item_id` on assignments.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iru_custom_profiles" "wifi" {
  name = "Wi-Fi"
}

# Reference the matching ID:
#   one(data.iru_custom_profiles.wifi.results).id
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) If set, only custom profiles whose name exactly matches are returned.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Matching custom profiles. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the profile is active.
- `id` (String) Library item ID.
- `mdm_identifier` (String) MDM payload identifier.
- `name` (String) Profile name.
